text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess shows up to our
meeting with
a furrowed expression.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ughhh! My head is still throbbing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I love having rose-petal baths, but the
smell of a
fine incense or perfume is also
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Roses are so beautiful, but they also
have strong
thorns—just like a fighting
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I just got the best idea! I should
round up
these different rose-scented
products...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And use them all at once! That way, I
can enjoy
the essence of roses even
more!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Their sweet fragrances will give an
explosive
boost to my princess level!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...But it turns out that using them all at
once was
overkill, and I ended up with
this massive
headache.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I aired my room out to get rid
of the
scent, but the headache still won't
go away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ouch! Ughh... It even hurts to raise my
voice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess is troubled by the
pain of her
seemingly chronic headache.
